question: The First Five Year Plan was released in the year ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The First Five-year Plan was floated in 1951 which mainly focused in the development of the primary sector.
 
• The First Five-Year Plan was based on the Harrod–Domar model with few modifications.
 
• This five years plan's president was Jawaharlal Nehru and Gulzarilal Nanda was the vice-president.
